source.version_signal: PFC 6-style example corpus with some legacy command spellings; verify every final command against the target PFC version.

evidence_tiers.tutorial: Feature semantics and minimal teaching sequence.
evidence_tiers.example: End-to-end workflow and file orchestration pattern.
evidence_tiers.verification: Numerical or analytical check suitable for V&V design.

entries.title: 2D granular workflow driver
entries.summary: Thin driver that sets case parameters, calls stage files, and saves/restores named milestones.

entries.title: 2D granular specimen generation
entries.summary: Deterministic packing build with explicit CMAT, boundaries, convergence, floater identification, and gauge initialization.

entries.title: 2D isotropic servo compaction
entries.summary: Updates servo forces from current specimen dimensions and stops only after stress and force-ratio tolerances pass.

entries.title: 2D biaxial loading stage
entries.summary: Separates stress-controlled preparation from strain-controlled loading and resets displacement before the test.

entries.title: 2D wall, Love-Weber, and regional stress utilities
entries.summary: Provides independent boundary, whole-specimen, and regional stress estimators for cross-checking.

entries.title: 2D measure and gauge strain utilities
entries.summary: Separates measure-region strain integration from gauge-particle strain estimates.

entries.title: 2D parallel-bond rock-test driver
entries.summary: Builds one bonded baseline, branches UCS and tension from the same state, and records a run log.

entries.title: 2D unbonded rock specimen
entries.summary: Uses density scaling only for assembly equilibration, restores automatic timestep control, then saves the unbonded state.

entries.title: 2D parallel-bond installation
entries.summary: Installs bonds in a distinct stage, resets displacement and residual contact force/moment, re-equilibrates, and saves a bonded baseline.

entries.title: 2D UCS test
entries.summary: Initializes measurement and crack callbacks before loading and halts after a confirmed post-peak stress drop.

entries.title: 2D direct-tension test
entries.summary: Shows particle-grip loading and independent measure/gauge instrumentation for tensile calibration.

entries.title: 2D bond-break fracture tracking
entries.summary: Converts bond-break events into typed fractures and batches expensive fragment recomputation.

entries.title: 2D basic CMAT ordering
entries.summary: Minimal evidence that default contact assignment should be defined explicitly and early.

entries.title: 2D multi-material CMAT slots
entries.summary: Uses ordered optional slots and type-specific defaults for glass, steel, and wall contacts.

entries.title: 2D current-contact versus future-contact assignment
entries.summary: Demonstrates that editing CMAT does not safely update current contacts until apply/contact commands are used.

entries.title: 2D bond gap and CMAT proximity
entries.summary: Shows that a positive installation gap may require proximity, contact detection, and CMAT application before bonding.

entries.title: 3D cylindrical rock specimen
entries.summary: Builds and trims a reproducible cylindrical assembly after equilibration and restores automatic timestep control.

entries.title: 3D parallel-bond installation
entries.summary: 3D analogue of the explicit bond-install/reset/re-equilibrate stage contract.

entries.title: 3D UCS test
entries.summary: Useful workflow evidence but also a warning that legacy command aliases must be version-checked.

entries.title: 3D bonded assembly tutorial
entries.summary: Compares bonded states with and without linear stiffness/force reset, making state-transition effects observable.

entries.title: 3D FISH callback ordering
entries.summary: Documents callback timing constraints, deterministic ordering, and explicit callback removal.

entries.title: 3D Python-driven UCS
entries.summary: Shows object creation, array masks, cycle callbacks, and metric extraction; adapt rather than copy because it contains duplicated notebook-style cells.

entries.title: 3D measure-porosity verification
entries.summary: Compares measurement-sphere porosity to closed-form values across probe sizes and resolutions.

entries.title: 3D wave-propagation verification
entries.summary: Reference route for dynamic-wave verification before application-scale simulations.

entries.title: 3D DFN generation and simplification
entries.summary: Stages DFN generation, density checks, trace/intersection analysis, connectivity, filtering, and combination with milestone saves.

entries.title: 3D thermal free-expansion verification route
entries.summary: Use as a feature-level verification precursor before thermomechanical application models.

entries.title: 3D one-way CFD coupling
entries.summary: Shows that coupled cases require an explicit auxiliary-file contract, not a standalone command file.
